items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) returned to practice Friday after DNPs Wed/Thu. Encouraging for Week 2 vs NO; likely Q/GTD after half of 5/150/1 in W1.
items.why: Returned Fri after two missed practices; day-to-day previously.
items.implication: Upgrade toward playable; monitor final designation/warmups. If sits, Bateman hierarchy lead.
items.opportunity: Full routes if active restores WR1 volume; reverse prior Bateman/Walker stashes if IN.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) DNP second straight day Thu; unlikely available Sunday vs LV. Chargers signed MVS; QJ/Tre Harris 90%+ routes without him in W1.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs ribs; team prep indicates sit.
items.implication: Sit/remove; Quentin Johnston primary beneficiary routes/targets.
items.opportunity: Johnston/Harris role expansion; deep-league Harris add.

items.text: Nico Collins hurt hamstring Wed practice (history of missing 5 games in 2024); DNP Thu/Fri after limited Wed. MRI/results key; routes 37/42 last week on Stroud dropbacks dominate hierarchy. Status in jeopardy for Week 2 vs CIN.
items.why: Hamstring tweak + history; consecutive DNPs after limited; doctors initially not serious but jeopardy.
items.implication: High risk OUT; remove from lineups pending final report. Beneficiaries Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel deep flex, Schultz TE bump.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Texans WR2/3 and TE see route/target spike on high-volume Stroud.

items.text: Falcons ruled out QB Michael Penix Jr. for Sunday vs CAR; Cooper Rush will start, Jack Strand backup. Expected after not ready.
items.implication: Downgrade ATL pass game (London/Pitts); Rush streaming low-end only.
items.opportunity: Slight London/Pitts volume risk with backup QB; no major beneficiary.

items.text: Brock Bowers (knee/meniscus) returned to practice Friday first time post-surgery. Sign recovery on track; participation TBD on final report vs LAC.
items.why: First practice since meniscus trim; HC hoped for midweek return.
items.implication: Door open for debut/active; if OUT Mayer fringe TE1 continues.
items.opportunity: If IN, immediate TE1 volume; reverse Mayer if unexpectedly active.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore AC joint sprain (shoulder) from TNF; not serious, day-to-day. Chance to play next week (vs LAC) but not lock. Ruled OUT TNF.
items.why: AC sprain confirmed not serious; X-rays, out for game.
items.implication: Missed TNF; monitor Week 3 availability. Short-term Bills WR volume to others.
items.opportunity: Temporary target bump for remaining BUF WRs if multi-week.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson 'ready to go' full practice; debut Sunday. Unclear how much earns vs Stevenson, but Pats desperate for explosives with AJ Brown IR; nice upcoming schedule.
items.why: Full participant, self-declared ready; Brown IR creates void.
items.implication: Monitor snap share/role; handcuff/upside stash with path to significant work.
items.opportunity: Explosive plays opportunity vs Stevenson committee; schedule PIT-JAX-BUF etc favorable.

items.text: If Zay Flowers (hamstring) can't go, Ravens WRs hierarchy: 1. Rashod Bateman 2. Devontez Walker 3. LaJohntay Wester etc. Lane already IR wrist.
items.why: Clear depth chart post-Lane IR + Flowers uncertainty.
items.implication: Bateman flex if Flowers sits; monitor Fri return reverse.

items.text: ETR Week 2 waivers injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; AJ Brown=Romeo Doubs; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller. Precise role fills.
items.implication: Priority adds for immediate snaps/routes if principals OUT.

items.text: DeVonta Smith LOVE @ TEN: 27% targets, 13.7 aDOT/3 deep W1. TEN allowed 85% catch/16 YPR to Jets WRs; 6th-most PPG to WRs since last yr.
items.implication: WR1/2 start confidence after tough W1.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE Week 2 vs IND: 21/24 RB touches thru 3Q (74% snaps), 40% target rate routes. IND allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry W1.
Ashton Jeanty LOVE @ LAC: 99 utilization W1 (tied Bijan), 19% target share last 10, 25+ touches 3/4 recent. Workhorse path.
items.implication: Strong RB start even in tough spot.

items.text: Dak Prescott LOVE vs WAS: home 21.3 PPG last yr; WAS torched 14.5 YPC/3 TDs W1. DAL top-5 implied total 27 in high-total game.
Marvin Harrison Jr. HATE vs SEA: 8% target share W1 (5th on team), zero RZ. SEA 3rd-fewest PPG to WRs since last season.
